groupStage.dropdownSummary: Predict how each team will finish in their group!
groupStage.hint1: You receive 1 point for each correct prediction.
groupStage.hint2: If you correctly predict every team in every group, you will earn an extra 2 points!
groupStage.hint3: You will be able to use these points to swap out wrong predictions in the Bracket Stage.
groupStage.hint4: However, if you use these points to make a swap, you "spend" them, and have less remaining points.
groupStage.hint5: These also decide ties. If two Brackets have the same points, your remaining Group Stage points act as the tiebreaker.

bracketStage.dropdownSummary: Complete your bracket predictions for the Tournament!
bracketStage.hint1: This Bracket Stage opens once all 32 teams have been decided.
bracketStage.hint2: You will have only a short window of time to fill out your predictions.
bracketStage.hint3: You get a fresh Bracket, regardless of your Group Stage predictions.
bracketStage.hint4: Group Stage Points and Bracket Points are separate.
bracketStage.hint5: Bracket Stage points are what decide the winners of pools.
bracketStage.hint6: If one of your predictions loses, you can swap it out using your Group Stage Points.
